messages.content:
You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figure 1, which of the following best characterizes the appearance of the pulmonary mass in the left lung base, considering its shape, density, and pleural contact, and correlates with the clinical history of hemothorax and pulmonary metastases from a giant cell tumor of bone?

A) A well-demarcated, homogeneously dense mass with no pleural contact.
B) An ill-defined, heterogeneously dense mass with wide contact with the pleura.
C) A well-demarcated, heterogeneously dense mass with wide contact with the pleura.
D) A round, homogeneously dense mass with calcification and minimal pleural contact.
E) An ovoid, homogeneously dense mass with wide pleural contact and signs of cavitation.
F) An irregular, heterogeneously dense mass with minimal pleural contact.
